name: Deep Industries
desc: Oilfield & gas-infrastructure services play with a strong order book and improving margins. Structural energy-capex tailwind, but execution and commodity-cycle sensitivity to watch.

name: Yasho Industries
desc: Specialty-chemicals maker (aroma, rubber & performance chemicals) with a major Q1 FY27 earnings inflection and a CRISIL upgrade. Capex-led growth story; watch margin durability and leverage.

name: SML Mahindra
desc: Commercial-vehicle maker (formerly SML Isuzu) with a Mahindra-led turnaround thesis. Volume recovery and margin expansion potential, offset by competition and cyclicality.

name: Ramkrishna Forgings
desc: Leading forgings player levered to CV, railways and exports diversification. Strong capex and order pipeline; cyclical end-markets and working-capital intensity are the key risks.

name: Tourism Finance Corporation
desc: Niche NBFC financing tourism/hospitality infrastructure, in an ownership/strategy transition. High-yield lending with asset-quality and concentration risks; a special-situation play.

name: Vadilal Industries
desc: Ice-cream & frozen-foods brand with a strong franchise and improving governance/margins. Consumption tailwind, but seasonality, competition and capital-allocation are watch-items.

name: GHCL Textiles
desc: Demerged textiles (yarn & home textiles) play — a value/cyclical bet on cotton spinning with capacity expansion. Commodity-margin volatility and end-demand cyclicality dominate.

name: Shadowfax Technologies
desc: Fast-scaling logistics/last-mile & quick-commerce delivery platform. High growth in a hot space, but profitability, competition and unit-economics remain the central questions.

name: 63 Moons Technologies
desc: Deep-value tech/exchange-infrastructure play with large cash, litigation recoveries and hidden-asset optionality. A special-situation, catalyst-driven thesis rather than a compounder.

name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery
desc: Regional diamond/jewellery retailer riding formalization and a consumption tailwind. Growth and brand potential offset by working-capital intensity, gold-price and execution risks.

name: Paushak
desc: Dominant, high-ROCE specialty-chemicals niche leader (phosgene derivatives) with a fortress balance sheet. A quality compounder; cyclicality and a premium valuation are the caveats.

name: Restaurant Brands Asia
desc: Burger King master-franchisee (India + Indonesia) — a turnaround/scale story chasing store-led growth and profitability. Execution, unit economics and losses are the key debate.

name: Kabra Extrusiontechnik
desc: Plastic-extrusion machinery leader with a high-optionality battery/energy-storage (Battrixx) pivot. Core cash-generation plus EV-supply-chain optionality; the new vertical is unproven.

name: Navin Fluorine International
desc: Premium fluorochemicals leader (HPP, specialty, CDMO) with a spectacular FY26 (rev +41%, PAT +130%). Elite franchise & China+1 tailwind, but partly cyclical and richly valued.

name: Omnitech Engineering
desc: Recently-listed Rajkot precision-engineering exporter with a ~₹3,000 Cr order book (~79% exports). Strong growth and margins, offset by a working-capital stretch and short listed history.

name: Sudeep Pharma
desc: Listed-2025 mineral-based pharma-excipient leader with a battery-grade iron-phosphate pivot. High-quality core plus optionality; a stretched working-capital cycle is the main flag.

name: Morepen Laboratories
desc: Multi-engine pharma turnaround (API, formulations, devices) with a sharp Q1 FY27 inflection (EBITDA +207%). SOTP re-rating story; a large GST contingency is the key red flag.

name: Palantir Technologies
desc: AI-software compounder (Q2 2026 rev +93%) with elite margins and Rule-of-40+ economics. Exceptional business and momentum; an extreme ~200x+ valuation is the sole but serious risk.

name: ELANTAS Beck India
desc: Debt-free, ALTANA-parented niche leader in wire enamels & insulating varnishes (ROCE ~43%). Elite quality with an electrification tailwind, but demanding (~50x vs ~13x industry) and low-float.

name: Standard Engineering Technology
desc: Hyper-growth top-3 glass-lined equipment maker (net debt-free, ₹1,000 Cr order book) pivoting into AI-datacenter engineering. Compelling multi-engine story, but priced for perfection (~67x) with a working-capital/cash-conversion flag.

name: Macpower CNC Machines
desc: Founder-led, net-debt-free, low-cost CNC machine-tool leader (~26% 5-yr CAGR) riding Make-in-India / import substitution, premiumizing via NEXA. Record FY26 (rev +27%, PAT +33%); but richly valued (~40-45x) on a cyclical small-cap with EBITDA-margin pressure, a much-larger rival (Jyoti CNC) and a thin float.

name: Action Construction Equipment
desc: Virtually debt-free market leader (world's #1 pick-n-carry crane maker, ICRA AA/A1+) playing margin-over-volume: EBITDA margin 14%→18% on flat FY26 revenue, Q1 FY27 re-accelerating (+20% rev), with a ₹575 Cr defence book & KATO heavy-crane JV. Bear: cyclical (FY26 flat) & fully valued (~30x).
